title: Interval fields take whole numbers within caps only
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as an Owner/Admin or as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings, open the "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates" (if the build shows "Maintenance schedules" instead, use that entry and record the label). Schedules are shared by the whole organization, whichever location is chosen in the header.
  3. The Add service form open (New schedule > Add service) with Distance and Engine hours ticked, so the calendar, mileage and engine-hours rows all show.
custom_steps:
1. In an interval value type 2.5, then -3, then 0.
  2. Try to type letters and symbols (e.g. "abc", "#") into a number field.
  3. Enter values above the caps: mileage 1,000,000; engine hours 100,000; days 1,000.
  4. Set the calendar operator to "At", leave the day and month empty and try to save the service.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • 2.5 is refused inline; -3 and 0 are refused inline on the same rule.
  • Letters and symbols do not enter the field; there is no error to show.
  • Values above the caps are refused: mileage stops at 999,999, engine hours at 99,999, days at 999.
  • The service cannot be saved while the "At" row has no day and month.
  • On the design the inline messages read "Enter a whole number." (2.5), "Enter a number greater than 0." (0) and "Choose a day and month." (the empty "At"). Write down the words you see; do not pass or fail on the wording.
  • On the design the number-field note reads "Digits only. Letters cannot be typed, so there is no error state."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10559 (S2, Add a routine service to a schedule), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S2 (What the number fields accept; S2-R9, S2-N2, S2-N5, S2-N6, S2-N7); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard V1; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-N2: “A decimal interval value is rejected inline”
  • S2-N5: “A number field accepts digits only. Letters and symbols do not enter the field, so there is no error to show”
  • S2-R9: “Interval values are whole numbers, minimum 1, with no decimals and no negatives. Mileage is capped at 999,999, engine hours at 99,999 and days at 999”
  • S2-N7: “A calendar "At" row cannot be saved without a day and a month”
  • S2-N6: “An interval of zero is rejected inline, on the same rule as a decimal and a negative”
  • Design board, artboard V1 (validation): “Enter a whole number.”
  • Design board, artboard V1 (validation): “Enter a number greater than 0.”
  • Design board, artboard V1 (validation): “Choose a day and month.”
  • Design board, artboard V1 (validation): “Digits only. Letters cannot be typed, so there is no error state.”
